notes: Target ambiguous: p.10 interpreted as PDF p.10 (printed p.606), which contains Figure 6, rather than printed article p.10 (article pages are 597–614). Five candidate unstandardized b paths, visually confirmed against the rendered PDF: expectations→satisfaction .314; expectations→disconfirmation -.903; disconfirmation→satisfaction .354; performance→disconfirmation 1.445; performance→satisfaction .583. Parenthetical values are explicitly standardized coefficients and are not substituted. All five bear ***, whose Figure 6 legend gives p < .01; the same-path narrative on printed p.607 reports p < .001 for all path coefficients. Both printed bounds retained as candidates, no exact p inferred. Figure 6 explicitly reports common analytic model n=905 participants; this is a field-scope candidate for parent review only, since the assigned row does not identify a path. No arithmetic derivation. No target chosen from audit ID or numeric matching. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
